G1_a_usage_line_is_a_grammar.the_claim: a usage line parses into slots for at least half the pages read, and a page is never read for a subcommand's contract when it names subcommands

G4_a_refusal_is_a_refinement.the_claim: at least one refusal is read and repaired into acceptance by the flag the program itself named

load_bearing_primary.why: OSWORLD_2_1_PARTIAL_GE_81_8 is the obligation a model-free action repertoire has to move: it is the one open row about DOING THINGS ON A COMPUTER, and its own failure axes (lost constraints, skipped verification) are what the goal check and the target-kind need are built to make mechanical. This round does not claim the row; it prices the mechanism that would have to carry it, on the only substrate available here (this sandbox's published pages).

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: REUSE and ADAPT were priced and are dead ends in this tree: THE_REPERTOIRE_IS_A_QUERY executed 164 printed options on real state and 0 of the 80 accepted ones changed a byte, and the ten-round demand-language arc bought 2 of 75 repairs. COMPOSE over the existing goal compiler fails because nothing in the tree turns a page into typed transitions. The primitive that was missing is the one built here: a usage line read as arity and argument kind, a flag read as the verb it governs, and a search over those transitions against a room typed by bytes. It is synthesized rather than integrated because no existing module reads a page's own grammar.

action_summary: Read a program's own page as a typed action grammar -- usage line as arity and argument kind, flag as the verb it governs, the summary sentence as the program's own claim -- and answer a need by a path over those transitions, filled from objects typed by their bytes, judged by the machine's own read-only programs.
